scope: Independent review of the exact local English body candidate only. Reviewer did not author/edit it and made no external reads, browser/account actions, publication or shared canonical edits.
release_readiness: NOT ASSESSED; full preservation/translation inventory and current product destination proof are unfinished.

checks.evidence: Saved Admin response targets the named existing published article; no new article is proposed.
The before HTML differs from the saved Admin body only by one final newline.
The exact saved Admin body occurs in the cookie-free article HTTP source.
Both saved HTTP sources match recorded byte counts and SHA256; this verifies recorded source evidence, not a new request or rendered behavior.
Parsed candidate has balanced ordinary article markup without scripts, forms, event behavior or theme changes.
Both exact product URLs and displayed short-/long-sleeve labels occur together in collection anchors.

Six checklist items cover recipients, exact charts, included pieces and quantities, material/care information, gift timing and returns/contact; useful unresolved questions are addressed before purchase.
The gift checklist and wearer-by-wearer selections align with the N2 angle described in GIFT_GUIDE_BRIEF.md. The native N2 asset and schedule were not independently inspected.
Explicitly says a group photo does not confirm a whole-family bundle; each wearer must have a suitable option, and current size availability is not promised.
Requires current measurements, the exact product/wearer chart, units and body-versus-garment distinction; links the completed sizing guide and discourages guessed sizes.
Existing child-sleepwear warning and CPSC link are preserved semantically and verbatim apart from the curly apostrophe in the link label.
Additional paragraph expressly rejects automatic growth upsizing, requires intended fit/label guidance, and says a pajamas listing is not proof of compliance.

Generic fabric/environmental benefits and universal wash/dry instructions are removed; exact product details and garment labels govern. Gauze is retained only within the observed product name, without an independent composition claim.
Delivery is expressly an estimate, not a guarantee; current return information and contact help are linked without inventing terms, discounts, services or delivery promises.
The prior universal bonding, popularity, lifetime memory and broad holiday/onesie/pet assortment assertions are replaced by practical buying checks and two observed collection examples.
Eight anchor occurrences target seven expected destinations; actual PDP/support/sizing arrivals remain unverified in this review.

Brief identifies body-only intent, incomplete preservation/translation inventory and PDP evidence, preview/cached-source limitations, and publication NOT RUN. This review grants no release-ready status.
Candidate and review make no measured acquisition, traffic, orders, sales or profit claim.

recommendations.item: Complete exact article-field baseline and complete global/market translation inventory; preserve omitted author/image/blog/createdAt and other fields, bind the mutation/rollback to current source and handle translation impact explicitly.

Complete current product destination readbacks for both named examples, including their wearer options, chart/included-piece information and any conflicting material/intended-use claims. Collection anchor labels alone do not certify variants, contents, materials or child sleepwear suitability.

Verify the actual seven destinations and affected desktop/mobile article behavior on the intended public theme; distinguish inherited preview state from MAIN acceptance. Preserve independent release/measurement windows.

limitations: Model editorial assessment, not human reader or conversion testing.
HTTP source files prove the recorded responses only; no independent current rendered storefront, stock, checkout, fulfillment or all-market verification.
N2 alignment is bounded to the supplied brief, not a native Pin asset/schedule readback.
The retained CPSC statement was checked for preservation; this reviewer did not newly review the external PDF or certify product/all-country compliance.
No mutation variables, final complete baseline, translation inventory, product-detail readback or after-publication evidence was available in this bounded assignment.
Title/URL/other-field preservation is proposed, not yet demonstrated by a mutation and after-state readback. No traffic or sales lift is claimed.
